title: OrthodoxConnect parish feed (v1)
description: Data contract between the OrthodoxConnect app and the parish website: public events, volunteer opportunities and needs for one parish. The site renders it with the orthodoxconnect-feed section. Served by the API (set ORTHODOXCONNECT_FEED_URL at build time, or fetch it in the builder) or read from the bundled sample file. Text fields may be plain strings or localized objects ({"en": ..., "ru": ...}).

version.description: Contract version. Breaking changes bump it.

isSample.description: true for placeholder data. The site then labels the section and every card as "Sample". The live API must send false or omit it.

id.description: Stable id in OrthodoxConnect (rendered as data-oc-id).

status.description: Only open and full items are shown.

startsAt.description: ISO 8601 with offset. Shown in site.timezone.

url.description: Deep link into OrthodoxConnect for RSVP / sign-up / pledge. null shows a disabled button.

cta.description: Button label override (defaults: RSVP, Sign up, I can help).
